headline: Seattle Pacific match Charleston for the division's most wins
dek: Seattle Pacific's home win over Simon Fraser was their sixteenth of the season, level with Charleston for the most of any programme in the division. They have drawn once and lost three times, and Western Oregon visit next.
displaced_by: results night: Seattle Pacific's sixteenth win drew them level with Charleston for the most wins in the division
